records.context: PERISCOPE (cpg0021, CP186A/B) publishes its corrected painting extracted image regions (``CorrDNA`` and the other painting image data channels) in the painting frame, but its own Cells and Nuclei masks are in the sequencing (SBS) frame. Its 04Align module records the shift between the two frames per site (``Align_Yshift_DAPI_Painting`` and ``Align_Xshift_DAPI_Painting`` in the site's ``Image.csv``; 3-77 px on CP186A Well 1). Painting features measured through those masks without that shift read the wrong pixels.
records.label: spacr.cpg_measure#1
records.source: PERISCOPE (cpg0021, CP186A/B) publishes its corrected painting crops (``CorrDNA`` and the other painting channels) in the painting frame, but its own Cells and Nuclei masks are in the sequencing (SBS) frame. Its 04Align module records the shift between the two frames per site (``Align_Yshift_DAPI_Painting`` and ``Align_Xshift_DAPI_Painting`` in the site's ``Image.csv``; 3-77 px on CP186A Well 1). Painting features measured through those masks without that shift read the wrong pixels.
records.translation: PERISCOPE (cpg0021, CP186A/B) birtir leiðrétta litunarútskurði sína (``CorrDNA`` og hinar litunarrásirnar) í hnitakerfi litunarmyndanna, en eigin Cells- og Nuclei-grímur þess eru í hnitakerfi raðgreiningar (SBS). Einingin 04Align skráir hliðrunina milli hnitakerfanna tveggja fyrir hvert svæði (``Align_Yshift_DAPI_Painting`` og ``Align_Xshift_DAPI_Painting`` í ``Image.csv`` svæðisins; 3-77 px á CP186A Well 1). Litunareiginleikar sem eru mældir með þessum grímum án hliðrunarinnar eru lesnir úr röngum mynddílum.
records.review_basis: Codex (OpenAI) AI translation and review on 2026-11-21 of the strings and docstrings item 998 (claude-998-impl @ 8e215d8875) adds: the cpg_painting_frame_shift setting label and tooltip, the spacr/cpg_measure.py messages and the spacr.cpg_measure API. No human or native-speaker signoff.

records.context: The ``cpg_measure`` phase reads each site's painting image layers, moves every image layer into the mask frame by the site's shift (``cpg_painting_frame_shift``), measures it with :func:`spacr.ops_sample.measure_phenotype_field`, flags the cells that touch the zero-filled band the shift leaves at the microscope field of view border (``painting_shift_border``) and records every applied shift in ``painting_frame_shift_<plate>_<well>.csv``.
records.label: spacr.cpg_measure#2
records.source: The ``cpg_measure`` phase reads each site's painting planes, moves every plane into the mask frame by the site's shift (``cpg_painting_frame_shift``), measures it with :func:`spacr.ops_sample.measure_phenotype_field`, flags the cells that touch the zero-filled band the shift leaves at the field border (``painting_shift_border``) and records every applied shift in ``painting_frame_shift_<plate>_<well>.csv``.
records.translation: Fasinn ``cpg_measure`` les myndlög litunarmyndanna fyrir hvert svæði, færir hvert myndlag í hnitakerfi grímunnar um hliðrun svæðisins (``cpg_painting_frame_shift``), mælir það með :func:`spacr.ops_sample.measure_phenotype_field`, merkir frumurnar sem snerta röndina sem hliðrunin skilur eftir við jaðar sjónsviðsins og fyllir með núllum (``painting_shift_border``) og skráir hverja hliðrun sem er beitt í ``painting_frame_shift_<plate>_<well>.csv``.

Every feature of a cell away from the band is the feature of the aligned image, except ``frac_high90`` and ``frac_low10``: they are thresholded on the whole microscope field of view's percentiles, and the band's zeros are part of the microscope field of view.

Every feature of a cell away from the band is the feature of the aligned image, except ``frac_high90`` and ``frac_low10``: they are thresholded on the whole field's percentiles, and the band's zeros are part of the field.
records.translation: Tafla frá :func:`spacr.ops_sample.measure_phenotype_field` ásamt ``painting_shift_border`` (fruman eða kjarni hennar snertir röndina sem hliðrunin fyllir með núllum). Sérhver eiginleiki frumu utan randarinnar er eiginleiki samstilltu myndarinnar, nema ``frac_high90`` og ``frac_low10``: þeir nota þröskulda sem byggjast á hundraðshlutamörkum alls sjónsviðsins, og núll randarinnar eru hluti sjónsviðsins.
